---
title: "Macro Monitor: 24-month backtest"
subtitle: "Every flag the rule raised in the last two years, and whether the move held"
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown
from itables import init_notebook_mode, show

from pdi import site

init_notebook_mode(connected=False)
bt, meta = site.load("macro", "flags_backtest")
s = meta.get("summary") or {}
```

The rule that raises a flag, and the rule for whether a flag mattered, were both written
before this backtest was run. A flag **held** if, over the following three months, the series
did not give back more than half of the flagged surprise. It **reversed** if it did, which
usually means a one-month blip or a figure that was later offset. Flags from the last three
months are **too early** to judge.

```{python}
#| output: asis
if not s:
    print(site.empty_state(meta, "Backtest"))
else:
    rate = s["own_flag_rate"]
    print(f'Since {s["window_start"]}, {s["readings_scored"]:,} monthly readings were scored and '
          f'**{s["flags"]} flags** were raised. Flags against own history were '
          f'{rate:.1%} of readings; a threshold of {meta["flag_z"]} spreads would flag about '
          f'1.2% of readings from a bell curve, so anything above that is fat tails or real '
          f'events.\n')
    print("| Kind of flag | Raised | Held | Reversed | Too early |\n|---|---|---|---|---|")
    for kind in ("own history", "neighbours"):
        k = s[kind]
        print(f'| Against {kind} | {k["flags"]} | {k["held"]} | {k["reversed"]} | {k["too early"]} |')
    print(site.finding_line(meta.get("finding")))
```

## Every flag

```{python}
if bt.empty:
    display(Markdown(site.empty_state(meta, "Flags")))
else:
    t = bt.assign(period=pd.to_datetime(bt["period"]).dt.strftime("%Y-%m"))[
        ["period", "country", "kind", "z", "outcome", "sentence"]].rename(columns={
        "period": "Month", "country": "Economy", "kind": "Against", "z": "Spreads",
        "outcome": "Outcome", "sentence": "What happened"}).round({"Spreads": 1})
    show(t, paging=True, pageLength=25, showIndex=False, classes="display compact",
         order=[[0, "desc"]])
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(site.source_note(meta))
```

"Held" does not mean the flag was important, only that the move was not undone. Whether a
flag mattered for anything else is not tested here.
